messages:
maria_sales: Quick one — Enterprise POC kickoff next Wed. Customer requires 7yr audit log retention, customer-managed KMS (BYOK) with quarterly key rotation, and HSM-backed signing for exported logs. They want a 12‑month committed capacity and asked if we can quote an "audit+KMS" addon + any one-time HSM integration fee. Need ballpark pricing and flag any legal/SLA items for deal desk. Pinged SE + security + deals :eyes:

alex_s: Thanks — couple clarifying q's: 1) POC expected traffic (tokens/day or reqs/s)? 2) Do they want immutable tamper-evidence (WORM) or just longer retention? Both change pricing.

maria_sales: POC is moderate: ~2M tokens/day at start, could scale. They specifically asked for tamper-evidence on exports (signed blobs) and ability to hand off logs to their SIEM monthly.

tim_eng: Technical notes: long retention is mostly storage + indexing cost. Two options we normally propose: TTL tiering (hot 30d, warm 11mo, cold archive blob for >1yr) or full indexed retention (expensive). HSM-backed signing requires Private or Dedicated with HSM keywrap support — hosted customers can do BYOK via KMS but not HSM signing of exports unless we provision a dedicated HSM instance.

sarah_security: Compliance checklist: HIPAA customers will require BAAs and documented key rotation policy. For SOC2, we'll need evidence of key management procedures and access logs for any key usage. BYOK imports must include key material format + attestation. Also call out export encryption-at-rest vs in-transit: exports should be signed (HSM) and encrypted with customer key for transit to their S3.

alex_s: Pricing structure we recommend for this ask (ballpark): - audit-retention addon = per-GB/month for cold storage + small per-tenant fixed surcharge for retention guarantees - BYOK/KMS integration = one-time onboarding fee (covering key import & attestation) - HSM signing = either monthly managed HSM fee (if we host) or one-time integration + support uplift (if customer provides HSM endpoints). Exact numbers depend on commit level. For a 12mo commit we typically layer a commit discount (tiered by spend).

jordan_deals: Deal desk notes: If final ARR on the contract (hosted + addons) > $200k/year we can approve up to 20% discount at SDR/AE level. Anything over that needs D-1 approval. One-time integration fees can be capitalized into commit if requested — that helps them hit commit tiers. Also we require a security addendum for BYOK/HSM and a short SLA appendix for retention guarantees.

maria_sales: Helpful. Can someone give a sample quote template lines I can paste into the customer email? I want short, non-binding numbers and callouts for required approvals and timing (POC next week).

alex_s: Paste this snippet and tweak numbers when you have the POC metrics:

```
Audit Retention Add-on (7yr) — Tiered retention: hot/warm/cold. Estimated storage uplift: ~X GB/month => $[per-GB-month] + $[tenant surcharge]/month.
BYOK (customer-managed KMS) — one-time onboarding & attestation: $[one-time].
HSM Export Signing — managed HSM or customer HSM integration: $[one-time or monthly].
12-month commit discount eligible; final discounts subject to deal desk approval.
Deliverables: security addendum, key attestation report, and retention SLA appendix.
```

sarah_security: Also add: "Key rotation schedule must be agreed and logged; emergency key-rotation playbook required for HIPAA customers."

jordan_deals: I'll pre-approve placeholder discounts in the quote (up to 10%) so you can send POC numbers; final approval after we see committed ARR and legal signoff. If they want HSM signing hosted by Redwood we need 2-3 weeks to provision and an SOW for the HSM work.

dealbot: @maria_sales — submitted "audit+kms addon" pre-approval request to Deal Desk (ref: DD-2026-492). Expect response within 48h. :clock1:

maria_sales: Awesome — I'll send the template and set expectations re: provisioning lead times. One last Q — is there a public doc I can link for the retention architecture + KMS BYOK steps?

alex_s: Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/retention-and-kms (internal) — includes sample export flow and required attestation artifacts.

maria_sales: Perfect. Thanks team :thumbsup:
